Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 105. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have mastered ranged weapons and can make
shots that others find impossible. You gain the following
benefits:
Attacking at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage
on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three-
quarters cover.
Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon
that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a
-5 penalty to the attack roll. If that attack hits, you
add +10 to the attack’s damage.
